predictions.selection: Edinburgh Rugby to win the match
predictions.body: Edinburgh have won all three opening rounds of the United Rugby Championship, beating Ulster 34-29 away, DHL Stormers 17-13 at Hive Stadium and Zebre Parma 29-12 in Parma. The Lions arrive after shipping 57 points at Loftus Versfeld in a 57-15 defeat to Vodacom Bulls, conceding 57 points in that match. Back Edinburgh to win the match at home on Friday.

predictions.selection: Vodacom Bulls to win the match
predictions.body: Vodacom Bulls have scored 104 points across two completed rounds, beating Zebre Parma 47-13 in Parma and thrashing the Lions 57-15 at Loftus Versfeld. Ulster drew 26-26 at home with Munster in round three but lost 34-29 at home to Edinburgh in round one, and now face a Bulls pack that has conceded only 28 points. The selection is Vodacom Bulls to win the match.

Zebre Parma have lost all three completed United Rugby Championship rounds, conceding 47 points at home to Vodacom Bulls, 40 at Cardiff and 29 at home to Edinburgh. Connacht have started badly too, losing 15-29 at home to DHL Stormers and 19-36 at Glasgow, but they return to Dexcom Stadium against a side that has conceded 116 points across those three rounds. The pick is Connacht to win the match.

predictions.selection: DHL Stormers to win the match
predictions.body: DHL Stormers opened with a 29-15 win at Connacht and beat Hollywoodbets Sharks 39-22 at DHL Stadium in round three, their only defeat a 17-13 loss at Edinburgh. Scarlets have one win from their completed matches, edging Benetton 27-26 in Llanelli after losing 21-15 at home to Cardiff. DHL Stormers to win the match is the selection.

predictions.selection: Tampa Bay Lightning to win the match
predictions.body: Tampa Bay Lightning are 7-2-0 through nine games with 31 goals scored and 23 conceded, and carry a three-game winning streak into Colorado. Colorado Avalanche are 5-4-1 with 41 goals for and 31 against, and have lost their last two. The league's own published quotes make Colorado a −129 favourite, so this is a deliberately contrarian call against the market. Selection: Tampa Bay Lightning to win the match.

flags.detail: The OLBG golf hub returned 'No tips found' at 16:25Z, so zero golf fixtures were discovered for today. That is an OLBG suppression behaviour (no open community tips), not evidence that no golf is being played.
The rugby league hub listed only 2027 outright markets (State of Origin, Super League, NRL). No match fixture was available, so the sport has no analysable events in this window.

Greyhound card times are rendered five hours behind the UK race times printed in the same row (e.g. '5:12 Towcester' shown as 'Today 12:12'), while URC and snooker rows show local European times. The hub prints no timezone, so no UTC start was derived for those rows.

Fixtures were confirmed against an official publisher for five sports only (baseball, ice hockey, basketball, rugby union, snooker) plus the motor-racing schedule. Tennis, cricket, darts, handball, volleyball, greyhounds, golf, Gaelic games and rugby league rows are discovery-only and every official field is blank.

On Tampa Bay @ Colorado our record-based estimate gives Tampa Bay 69.2% while the league's published, de-vigged quotes imply 46.4% — a 22.8-point disagreement. Both readings are published; neither is treated as the truth.

Every NBA team has played one game. No team-specific strength input exists yet, so NBA prices use a single disclosed league-average home prior (0.55) and are labelled Low. They are placeholders, not team reads.
Starting pitchers are not published in the MLB schedule response, so the World Series total is not pitcher-adjusted and should not be compared with a bookmaker total.

Both Northern Ireland Open quarter-finals have verified fixture details and verified results, but no published head-to-head strength input, so no price was originated. WST prize-money rankings were read and are shown as context only.

The Munster GAA fixture list was read, but the OLBG club fixtures (St Finbarrs v Nemo Rangers, Moycullen v Salthill-Knocknacarra, both 25 Oct) were not located in the page portion read. They stay unverified and no price was originated.
pdc.tv served a cookie-consent shell with no schedule content, so all 12 darts fixtures on the OLBG hub remain unverified against the governing body. No price was originated.
atptour.com returned navigation and footer only (client-rendered scores), so the nine OLBG tennis fixtures remain unverified. No price was originated.
gbgb.org.uk/race-card/ returned HTTP 404, so no runner, trap or going data could be confirmed for the 15 discovered races.

The brief's two rules do not overlap much: a price inside −250…+10000 implies a probability of at most 71.4%, while High requires at least 70%. That leaves a 1.4-point window. This desk enforces both rules literally, so 0 selections qualify in-band and 2 High selections are published out-of-band in a disclosed ledger.
OLBG lists only an outright race-winner market for the United States Grand Prix. With a 20-driver field no single runner reaches 70%, and there is no head-to-head or handicap market to price.
OLBG renders the World Series opener as 'Today 20:00'. MLB's own feed gives 2026-10-24T00:00:00Z, which is 20:00 ET on 23 October. Both are consistent; the UTC date differs from the US local date.
The URC match centre states 'All times shown are Local' without publishing an offset, so no UTC start was derived for the five URC fixtures. OLBG's rendered times are recorded separately.

Only two Round 2 scorelines were captured before the page response was truncated, so form margins for Cardiff, Sharks, Connacht, Zebre, Edinburgh, Lions, Bulls, Ulster, Stormers and Scarlets are computed from the matches actually read, with the sample size printed beside each price.
